g.text: ESP32 ULTRA-MINIMALIST SYSTEM POWER & INTERFACE SCHEMATIC
Single 1000µF Buffer Architecture | Zero External Regulators | Full Optical Relay Isolation | Complete EasyEDA Netlist
★ THE ONLY EXTRA POWER PART ON PCB
1. HLK-5M05 feeds 5V directly to ESP32 VIN (Pin 15) and GND (Pin 14).
2. Relay coils are powered from 5V (JD-VCC) — isolated from 3.3V rail.
3. ESP32 3V3 Pin (30) powers opto LEDs (~8mA) + IR sensor (~0.5mA).
4. ESP32 GND Pin (29) supplies solid ground return to all peripherals.
Primary isolated AC mains power source. >5mm slot isolation.
ONLY EXTRA PART: Buffers relay inrush; stops ESP32 brownouts.
Powers via VIN (Pin 15). Internal LDO produces 3.3V system logic.
JD-VCC to +5V, VCC to 3.3V. Blue shorting jumper REMOVED!

1. Keep AC Live/Neutral traces separated from low-voltage DC by >= 5.0mm (or mill an isolation slot). 2. Connect HLK-5M05 5V & GND directly to ESP32 VIN/GND with C1 in parallel. 3. Remove the relay board blue jumper.
